Context: 5. Reinstatement

7. Review of the period of suspension revoked pending proceedings. If an order has been passed before conclusion of the departmental/ Court proceedings as to pay and allowances for and treatment of the period of suspension revoked before conclusion of the inquiry/ Court case, it is only a provisional order. After conclusion of the inquiry/ Court case, the said order should be reviewed on its own motion and a final order passed under the directive principles mentioned at headings 2 to 6 ante.
